versions.changelog: Security: TLS verification by default (--cacert / OBSIDIAN_CA_CERT), removed all curl -sk; declarative security frontmatter + prompt-injection block; destructive-op (PUT/DELETE/PATCH) confirmation; Obsidian-scoped triggers; README verify step no longer prints the API key.

Security hardening (audit remediation): removed /proc/environ credential scrape and all hardcode-the-API-key guidance; added --cacert TLS guidance over blanket curl -k. Fixed PATCH-at-heading headers (Operation/Target-Type/Target per plugin 3.x). Manual install now pins to a release tag.

v1.1.0: real-world pitfalls from deployment — trailing slash requirement on directory endpoints, correct root endpoint is / only (not /api/healthz), shell variable expansion caveat with exec tool, output formatting rules (never dump raw JSON), improved troubleshooting with 40400 root cause and fix

Initial release — full Obsidian vault control via the Local REST API plugin. Cross-platform (Windows/macOS/Linux), no obsidian-cli required. Read, write, append, patch, search, delete, list and run commands.
